{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "RCLike.cWeight",
      "informal_name": "Constant weight function on finite type ι",
      "kind": "abbrev",
      "type": "{ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → ι → ℝ",
      "informal_description": "The constant function from a finite type $\\iota$ to $\\mathbb{R}$ that maps every element to $\\frac{1}{\\#\\iota}$, where $\\#\\iota$ denotes the cardinality of $\\iota$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.Inner"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sum_centroidWeightsIndicator_eq_one_of_nonempty",
      "informal_name": "Sum of Uniform Centroid Weights Equals One for Non-Empty Finite Sets",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι],\n  s.Nonempty → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1",
      "informal_description": "Let $ k $ be a division ring of characteristic zero, $ \\iota $ a finite type, and $ s $ a non-empty finite set of elements of $ \\iota $. The sum of the uniform centroid weights indicator function over $ s $, which assigns weight $ 1/#s $ to each element of $ s $ and zero otherwise, equals 1. Formally, $ \\sum_{i \\in \\iota} \\text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(s, k, i) = 1 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Centroid"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sum_centroidWeightsIndicator_eq_one_of_card_ne_zero",
      "informal_name": "Sum of Centroid Weights Equals One for Non-Empty Finite Sets",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι],\n  s.card ≠ 0 → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1",
      "informal_description": "Let $ k $ be a division ring of characteristic zero, $ \\iota $ a finite type, and $ s $ a finite set of elements of $ \\iota $ with non-zero cardinality $ |s| \\neq 0 $. The sum of the centroid weights indicator function $ s.\\text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(k, i) $ over all $ i \\in \\iota $ equals 1. This function assigns weight $ 1/|s| $ to each element in $ s $ and 0 otherwise, so the total sum is $ \\sum_{i \\in \\iota} \\frac{1}{|s|} \\cdot \\mathbf{1}_s(i) = 1 $, where $ \\mathbf{1}_s $ is the indicator function of $ s $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Centroid"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sum_centroidWeightsIndicator_eq_one_of_card_eq_add_one",
      "informal_name": "Sum of Centroid Weights Equals One for Finite Sets with Cardinality $n + 1$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ},\n  s.card = n + 1 → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1",
      "informal_description": "Given a finite set $s$ of cardinality $n + 1$ over a division ring $k$ with characteristic zero, the sum of the centroid weights indicator function for $s$ equals 1, i.e., $\\sum_{i} \\text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(s, k, i) = 1$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Centroid"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.geom_mean_weighted_of_constant",
      "informal_name": "Weighted Geometric Mean Equals Constant Value with Non-Zero Weights",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ),\n  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) → ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) → (∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → z i = x) → ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = x",
      "informal_description": "For a finite set $ s $, let $ w $ and $ z $ be functions from an index type to $ \\mathbb{R} $, with $ w_i \\geq 0 $ and $ z_i \\geq 0 $ for all $ i \\in s $. Suppose the sum of $ w_i $ over $ s $ is 1, and for every $ i \\in s $, if $ w_i \\neq 0 $, then $ z_i = x $. Then, the weighted geometric mean $ \\prod_{i \\in s} z_i^{w_i} $ equals $ x $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.MeanInequalities"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Constant weight function on finite type ι
items.informal_description: The constant function from a finite type $\iota$ to $\mathbb{R}$ that maps every element to $\frac{1}{\#\iota}$, where $\#\iota$ denotes the cardinality of $\iota$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Uniform Centroid Weights Equals One for Non-Empty Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι],
  s.Nonempty → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1
items.informal_description: Let $ k $ be a division ring of characteristic zero, $ \iota $ a finite type, and $ s $ a non-empty finite set of elements of $ \iota $. The sum of the uniform centroid weights indicator function over $ s $, which assigns weight $ 1/#s $ to each element of $ s $ and zero otherwise, equals 1. Formally, $ \sum_{i \in \iota} \text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(s, k, i) = 1 $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Centroid Weights Equals One for Non-Empty Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι],
  s.card ≠ 0 → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1
items.informal_description: Let $ k $ be a division ring of characteristic zero, $ \iota $ a finite type, and $ s $ a finite set of elements of $ \iota $ with non-zero cardinality $ |s| \neq 0 $. The sum of the centroid weights indicator function $ s.\text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(k, i) $ over all $ i \in \iota $ equals 1. This function assigns weight $ 1/|s| $ to each element in $ s $ and 0 otherwise, so the total sum is $ \sum_{i \in \iota} \frac{1}{|s|} \cdot \mathbf{1}_s(i) = 1 $, where $ \mathbf{1}_s $ is the indicator function of $ s $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Centroid Weights Equals One for Finite Sets with Cardinality $n + 1$
items.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : DivisionRing k] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Finset ι) [CharZero k] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ},
  s.card = n + 1 → ∑ i, Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator k s i = 1
items.informal_description: Given a finite set $s$ of cardinality $n + 1$ over a division ring $k$ with characteristic zero, the sum of the centroid weights indicator function for $s$ equals 1, i.e., $\sum_{i} \text{centroidWeightsIndicator}(s, k, i) = 1$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Geometric Mean Equals Constant Value with Non-Zero Weights
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) → ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) → (∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → z i = x) → ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ w i = x
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $, let $ w $ and $ z $ be functions from an index type to $ \mathbb{R} $, with $ w_i \geq 0 $ and $ z_i \geq 0 $ for all $ i \in s $. Suppose the sum of $ w_i $ over $ s $ is 1, and for every $ i \in s $, if $ w_i \neq 0 $, then $ z_i = x $. Then, the weighted geometric mean $ \prod_{i \in s} z_i^{w_i} $ equals $ x $.
